checks.text: the PDF carries a signature dictionary with a byte range (a seal)
the seal holds a CMS signature value (not empty)

notes: A person opens the PDF in Adobe Reader: the seal present and intact, signer unverified (RECORD_SEALING=local), and a copy with one changed byte shows the seal broken. The script found the signature dictionary, byte range and CMS value in place.
